BIPA_BRAIN_INTRO: NeurOne collects your brainwave (EEG) data during sessions to provide neurofeedback and to adapt stimulation settings in real time. Brainwave data is sensitive personal information — biometric data under applicable law — and NeurOne treats it accordingly.
BIPA_BRAIN_QUESTION: Do you consent to NeurOne collecting and using your brainwave data as described above?
BIPA_DISCLOSURE:
Illinois residents: please read before continuing.

NeurOne collects and stores your electroencephalogram (EEG) brainwave patterns. Under the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA, 740 ILCS 14), these patterns are biometric identifiers and biometric information.

Purpose: your EEG data is used to deliver and adapt your sessions and to display your own results. It is stored only on your device, encrypted with a key derived from your own biometric or PIN. NeurOne cannot read it.

Retention and destruction: your biometric data is retained on your device under your control. It is permanently destroyed when you perform a device factory reset, and in any case within the timeframe set out in our publicly available biometric retention and destruction policy.

NeurOne will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from your biometric information, and will not disclose it without your separate written consent except as required by law.

By tapping "I Agree" you provide your written release to collect and store your biometric data as described above.
BIPA_STEP1_BODY_1: NeurOne captures electroencephalogram (EEG) data — the faint electrical signals produced when neurons in your brain fire. This data powers real-time neurofeedback and closed-loop stimulation during your sessions.
BIPA_STEP1_BODY_2: The next three screens explain how this data is protected, what it is used for, and the limits on how it can ever be used. Please read each one before deciding.
BIPA_STEP1_CARD: EEG brainwave patterns are biometric identifiers under Illinois BIPA (740 ILCS 14), special-category personal data under GDPR Article 9, and consumer health data under Washington MHMD. They identify you as uniquely as a fingerprint — and the law requires your explicit authorisation before we can collect them.
BIPA_STEP2_BODY: Your EEG data never leaves your NeurOne device. It lives in a dedicated encrypted partition that only you can unlock.
BIPA_STEP2_BULLET_1: Encrypted with AES-256 — the key is derived from your own biometric or PIN. NeurOne cannot generate or hold this key.
BIPA_STEP2_BULLET_2: Never transmitted to NeurOne servers, including for support, diagnostics, or troubleshooting.
BIPA_STEP2_BULLET_3: Backed up only to your own local storage or end-to-end encrypted personal cloud — never to NeurOne infrastructure.
BIPA_STEP3_BODY: Your brainwave data is used exclusively to deliver the NeurOne experience on your device. These are the only permitted uses, and the limits are absolute.
BIPA_STEP3_LIMIT_1: Sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from your biometric data
BIPA_STEP3_LIMIT_2: Share it with any third party without your separate written consent, except as required by law
BIPA_STEP3_PURPOSE_1: Session delivery — powering real-time neurofeedback and adapting stimulation parameters closed-loop
BIPA_STEP3_PURPOSE_2: Displaying your own session results to you within the app
BIPA_STEP3_PURPOSE_3: Research, only with your separate explicit consent for each individual study

BIPA_STEP4_INTRO: Below is the legally required written release under BIPA (740 ILCS 14/15(b)) and the equivalent provisions of GDPR Article 9 and Washington MHMD. Please read it in full, then check the box and tap "I Authorize" to proceed.
BIPA_STEP4_RELEASE_TEXT:
I authorize NeurOne Inc. to collect, store, and use my electroencephalogram (EEG) brainwave data — which constitutes biometric identifiers and biometric information under Illinois BIPA (740 ILCS 14), special-category personal data under GDPR Article 9, and consumer health data under Washington MHMD — for the purposes of session delivery, neurofeedback display, and closed-loop stimulation adaptation.

I understand that:
• This data is encrypted with AES-256 and stored only on my NeurOne device
• NeurOne cannot access, read, or decrypt this data at any time
• The data is retained on my device until I request deletion or perform a factory reset, at which point it is permanently destroyed via hardware-level secure erase (eMMC SANITIZE), consistent with NeurOne's publicly available biometric data retention and destruction policy
• NeurOne will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from this data
• NeurOne will not share this data with any third party without my separate written consent, except as required by law

I can revoke this authorization at any time from Settings → Privacy → Manage EEG Data Consent. Revoking authorization prevents future EEG data collection but does not retroactively erase data already stored on my device (use factory reset for full erasure).
CONSENT_COMPLETE_BODY: You can review and update your consent decisions at any time from the Privacy tab.
CONSENT_IRREVERSIBILITY_NOTICE:
Once your anonymised data has been included in a published study, it cannot be individually withdrawn from that dataset. This is a fundamental property of aggregate anonymised data required by Common Rule (45 CFR 46).

However, because NeurOne anonymises your data fresh from your device for each study, withdrawing consent immediately and permanently stops any further data from flowing to any future dataset — including data from sessions that occurred before your withdrawal.

Your session recordings remain on your device under your sole control at all times.

SETUP_AUTONOMOUS_BODY: Upload a session protocol to the hub so it runs automatically from any USB-C power bank — no phone required.
SETUP_BLE_CARD_BODY: Make sure the NeurOne hub is powered on. The green LED on the left temple should be breathing steadily. Connect via Bluetooth or USB-C.
SETUP_COMPLETE_HINT: Head to the Session tab to begin your first session.

SETUP_ERROR_IMPEDANCE_FAILED: High impedance on %@. Moisten the scalp under those electrodes and retry.
SETUP_ERROR_NOT_CONNECTED: Hub not connected. Connect via USB-C or Bluetooth.
SETUP_ERROR_NO_ZONE_MODULES: No modules detected yet. Seat at least one module and wait for it to be confirmed.
SETUP_ERROR_SAFETY_ACK_REQUIRED: Please read and acknowledge the safety information to continue.
SETUP_ERROR_TIMEOUT: Hardware confirmation timed out. Ensure the hub is connected and powered.
SETUP_ERROR_ZONE_MISSING: A module is seated but could not be identified in %@. Re-seat it and wait for this phone to confirm.
SETUP_INSTR_BLE: Power on the hub and connect via Bluetooth or USB-C. The green power LED should be breathing steadily. Tap Confirm once connected.
SETUP_INSTR_BOA_DIAL: Turn the Boa dial clockwise until the headset sits firmly on your head. The bridge should rest comfortably above your ears. All five electrode pods should touch your scalp.
SETUP_INSTR_CALIBRATION: The EEG amplifier is calibrating its internal reference. This takes about 2 seconds and eliminates drift across all 8 channels. Stay still.
SETUP_INSTR_COMPLETE: Your NeurOne is set up and calibrated. You're ready for your first session.
SETUP_INSTR_ELECTRODE_PODS: Press each electrode pod lightly against your scalp. Each pod travels ±12mm independently, so you don't need to dial tighter to reach every contact point. Remove any hydration caps from the electrode tips now.
SETUP_INSTR_HYDRATION: Confirm you have removed the moisture-barrier hydration caps from all electrode tips. Store the caps in the provided case for future storage sessions.
SETUP_INSTR_IMPEDANCE: Stay still while the app checks signal quality. Good contact = green. Moistening your hair slightly under the electrodes can help if you see orange.
SETUP_INSTR_PROTOCOL: Choose a starting session protocol. You can change this at any time from the Session tab.
SETUP_INSTR_SAFETY: Review the following safety information before your first session.
SETUP_INSTR_WELCOME: This short setup confirms your NeurOne is ready for its first session. It takes about 3 minutes.
SETUP_INSTR_ZONE_MODULES: Rest the helmet on a surface and press each module into a socket until it clicks. This phone confirms each one aloud as it seats, and the list below updates. Install as many modules as your configuration uses.
SETUP_PROTOCOL_CARD_BODY: These protocols are pre-loaded on your hub. You can change your default session at any time from the Session tab.
SETUP_PROTOCOL_STORED_MESSAGE: Protocol stored. Hub will run session without phone.

SETUP_SAFETY_CONTRAIN_2: Do not use if you have a personal or family history of epilepsy or seizure disorder.
SETUP_SAFETY_CONTRAIN_4: Do not use on broken, irritated, or recently tattooed skin.
SETUP_SAFETY_CONTRAIN_5: Discontinue and consult a physician if you experience headache, nausea, or visual disturbance.
SETUP_SAFETY_CONTRAIN_6: Not for use under 16 years of age.
